content: Paul Felix koma te den te sanamaram
Day 5 namaram se priest supuling Ananias mu Caesarea nama kaparam. Nu ko kari gira saki se law kari Tertullus nongorak namaram. Ale nunga bala Paul te den te betemonko mu governor manorman.

Se kam Paul auram se utu naguram mu, Tertullus nunga den mu iwita balu Felix koma te beteram: “Ana tom maiya biya bagara lila ni bowa ningi bagaman, se nika ikia ningo mu te mel suen biya anananga sor ningi magaram kueneram mu ni nungem burangerem.
Se ana nanga wonong wonong suen biya ningi pempem la ni ko ko ninguru amilmilasan.
Bore te se, ani nika tom tawun biya me iluwekko, bare aninga angamang mu tom katirta aisu se, anananga den tukunang ewere balik se ikiko.
“Ana kari imi arigiman mu, nu ikup memek betera ko kari. Nu Juda alo ali lilim ningi mu nongomang atumuso se kager daong barasoso.
Nu kariimet sang pagaman ale anananga beteman, nunga bala Nazarene, wore nunga supuling bo.
Se mel bo tala mu, anananga temple mu kuwim laili wore karur tugu kam beteram se, ana ko ilu talipaman.
Se ni keta nu isaru gurungumur ale asele ana noko den balsan imi ko nunguning ikiko.”
Se Juda alo suen la Tertullus den balam mu atumu sangarukasan ale den mu nunguning makasan.
Paul Felix moke te numi duap balam

Se governor Paul munakarukko ko kiwa tuam se, nu den koma mam: “Ani ikisam ni yia suen biya kariimet imi nunga ningi den tutera ale nunga ko ura bita lagerem. Bore te se ani amilmil te aimi duap balsam.
Ani Jerusalem kagin ko tairem mu, ko day 12 me namaram. Ni keta duap kupuko neger mu arikko.
Nuna ani kari bo ilak temple ningi den tagiwerem se me agarkaman. Agi synagogue bo ningi agi, wonong kower bo ningi kariimet ikup betemonko nongomang me patawuwerem, mena.
Ewere te se, bala ani angimik ko baluwasam sumu awuk ko nunguning balmon se ni ikiko ya? Mena.
Bare ani wetang te la balsam mu, ani anananga girigir alo nunga Kaem nup perr tusam ale Lage Nunguning ko lage karo tusam. Se borta nuna balsan ale kagin gotek bo iru masan.
Ani mel suen la Law baluwoso mu se, Prophet alo nunga batoga te mu ani karogo angamang motam suanta.
Ale ani kariari imi nongorak ana nanga loagara koma suanta, Kaem kariimet kuera mu, ningo diram ta, memek ago ta, mu suen la nunga maraguwurok se barasamonko.
Bore te se ani tom suen biya Kaem motam te, se kariimet nomotam te, aga angamang motam ningo la se diram la anirukko sail tagi lagasam.
“Ani yia saki ko Jerusalem beterem ale lagakasam. Bare aking kariimet sang nunga nuguting giem ale aga kariimet ningi kituwura guat mu nungaru se Kaem tama bita tuekko tairem.

Ale ani laili kaura ko munan beterem ale angimik ikup mena, temple ningi munan umu bitawerem se agarkaman. Tom umu te mu kariimet biya bo ani agarak me bagaman agi, ani daiga bagara ningo ko munan bo me maguwuwerem, mena tala.
Bare Asia sor ko Juda sang tom umu te karogo bagaman. Ani tom mu te memek i beterem agi mu, nuna awuk se aitak me taiman ale balu pagorsan?
Se awiriya bagasan imi, tom ani Sanhedrin biguwura motam te sanamerem se aga memek i ikiman agi mu balmonko.
Agi den suanta tom ani nongoma te sanamerem ale sail te airem ale: ‘Kariimet kuera mu aking barasamonko’ bala mu balem, borta ko agi, ani aitak nina nemekete sanamiwasam,’ ” mam.

Paul uwutata balam. Se Felix maingkala Lage Nunguning mu ikia se munak tom tukunangta ko to iluwam, ale mam, “Lysias, kager kari nunga supuling biya mu tairuk asele, ani munak imi aguwaya nama sanamaram mu balik se ikialko,” mam.

Ale nu kager kari supuling Paul bitaruwaram mu maonam, Paul ilak nama ninguru bitaru se bagamonko mam. Ale nu kuring katir tumon ale ko tiran alo karogo la kuring nungarmon se noko ikup guyak te am sangarmonko maonam.
Day sang namaram se Felix ko nuwus Drusilla ilak taiman. Drusilla mu Juda imet. Se Felix Paul ko den beteram se tairam ale Jesus Kristus ko nangamang ningi nunguning ko munan balukaso se ikikaso.

Se Paul balam nama, munan ningo diram, se nanga bagara aolak ko bitua ningo se, tom nukum te tutera ko munan umu baluwaram se, Felix nguangaram, ale mam, “Aitak ko bala mu, balem terong mam se, am namarko! Udagi tom kuring bo arigek mu aking balik se tairko,” mam.
Nu munan umu Paul kote bita se mu, noko ikia yumura mu Paul numi te bataguru taukko, manga sang nu tuokko i makaso. Ale tom suen biya arukaso se taikaso, se ilak munaka lagakaso.
Yia ilagala namaram, se Porcius-Festus mu Felix kuwim tam. Se Felix Juda alo nongomang motam nunga iwita, Paul talipara ningi am beteram se bagakaso.

footnotes.text: Batoga saki girakala ko mu te den imi ago aniso: “Ale nangata nanga Law te ko den ariginakko. Bare kager kari nunga supuling Lysias mu tairam, ale sail te nagiting te bataguru tam. Ale balam, kari nu den ningi betemonko mu taimon ni kema te den arigimonko mam.”
Lage Nunguning: Nu Jesus ko munan ko balso: Acts 9:2; 19:9,23; 22:4.
Kariimet kueman mu aking barasamonko: John 5:28-29.
Kris alo nunga sikisaki Jerusalem bagakasan mu nunga sangorman: Romans 15:25-26.
